title: Instructional Design of Training Programs
overview: Effective learning programs are those carefully crafted to address performance gaps and drive business outcomes. This course provides a practical, hands-on approach to instructional design, applying key principles in a business context. Participants will learn how to translate learning theories into tailored, action-oriented development initiatives. The course equips learners with the skills to improve performance, guides instructors in delivering focused learning, and helps training professionals recommend optimal learning solutions. It is highly practical, aiming to develop proficiency in every phase of instructional design.
audience: This course is ideal for trainers, instructional designers, training and development professionals, talent management specialists, organizational development professionals, and HR practitioners who want to excel in instructional design.
methodology: This interactive workshop uses a range of teaching methods, including presentations, roundtable discussions, practical exercises, and case study analysis. The course is structured around four key pillars: conceptual learning, experience sharing, hands-on practice, and scenario analysis.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Define a learner-centered environment and explain key instructional design principles
Develop a comprehensive project management plan for learning initiatives
Map out a detailed learning journey, including task inventories, testing strategies, and ROI measurement tools
Create learning materials and tools for both learners and instructors
Guide successful learning implementations through effective planning and communication
Design an evaluation plan to assess learning outcomes and ensure continuous improvement
